summary: Camera shake / collision-reaction computation. Selects the current camera entry as a stride-160 element (index = this+0x14, base = this+0xC), negates its position as a reference point, and, when the enable flag this+0x4 is set and the entry flag (byte +0x74 & 4) allows it, scans the vehicle array (count dword_5C329C, pointers dword_7C54F0) for a vehicle whose squared distance is below 250.0 and whose speed (sqrt of velocity at +88) exceeds 35.0. On hit it computes a proximity-derived collision strength and invokes CollisionResponseWithRandomPerturbation; on no hit it falls through to StateActivatedPositionSaveRestore. It then reads the local player vehicle data (dword_7C54E0), dispatches a vtable method at camera-entry dispatch+24, applies position/orientation processing (UtilityFunction_1cd0), converts two angle fields from degrees to radians (0.01745433) and applies them (sub_542050), sets two fields (TwoFieldSetterCall) and returns ConditionalFloatSetter of the entry float at +0x48.
